name: sortable-board
title: Sortable board
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Project board with category tabs and counts, search, list or grid, a homepage switch per row, and edit.

meta.descriptionEs: Proyectos con pestañas de categoría, búsqueda, lista o cuadrícula, interruptor de portada y editar.

examples.title: Proyectos de Acme
examples.description: Cinco trabajos ficticios. La portada y el orden viven en el estado de la página.

meta.usage:
<SortableBoard
  items={projects}
  categories={categories}
  onReorder={reorder}
  onToggleHomepage={toggle}
  onEdit={edit}
  homepageLabel="Portada"
/>

api.name: items / categories
api.description: Rows and the tabs. Counts include the current search.

api.name: onReorder
api.description: Full id order, including rows hidden by the filter.

api.name: onToggleHomepage
api.description: Optimistic switch. Rejects roll the switch back.

api.name: view / query / filter
api.description: Optional. Uncontrolled state is the default.

docs: The board does not know about a database. Pass the callbacks from your adapter.
